CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

'=============================================================
' FORM: F_SystemSettings
'
' PURPOSE:
'   Shows setup readiness for eight master-data areas.
'
' A SAVED RECORD IS INCOMPLETE WHEN:
'   Any applicable business field is Null, blank or spaces only.
'
' EXCLUDED FROM COMPLETENESS:
'   - AutoNumber primary keys
'   - CreatedOn and UpdatedOn system timestamps
'   - Notes and Description fields
'   - Calculated child/subform records
'   - Customer part numbers
'   - Item part numbers and item suppliers
'   - Template material and tool lines
'   - Warehouse-location subform rows
'
' IMPORTANT:
'   False is a valid Yes/No value.
'   Zero is a valid numeric value unless a rule explicitly says
'   that the number must be greater than zero.
'
' REQUIRED FORM CONTROL ADDED FOR THIS VERSION:
'   Label named lblIncompleteSummary (unbound).
'=============================================================


'=============================================================
' CACHED METRICS - LOADED ONCE PER REFRESH
'=============================================================

Private mCustomerTotal As Long
Private mCustomerIncomplete As Long

Private mSupplierTotal As Long
Private mSupplierIncomplete As Long

Private mCategoryTotal As Long
Private mCategoryIncomplete As Long

Private mUnitTotal As Long
Private mUnitIncomplete As Long

Private mItemTotal As Long
Private mItemIncomplete As Long

Private mTemplateTotal As Long
Private mTemplateIncomplete As Long

Private mWarehouseTotal As Long
Private mWarehouseIncomplete As Long

Private mLocationTotal As Long
Private mLocationIncomplete As Long


Private Sub cmdUserManagement_Click()

    DoCmd.OpenForm "F_UserManagement", _
        View:=acNormal, _
        WindowMode:=acDialog

End Sub
'=============================================================
' FORM EVENTS
'=============================================================

Private Sub Form_Load()

    RefreshSetup

End Sub


Private Sub Form_Activate()

    RefreshSetup

End Sub


'=============================================================
' MAIN REFRESH
'=============================================================

Private Sub RefreshSetup()

    On Error GoTo Err_Handler

    LoadSetupMetrics

    UpdatePartners
    UpdateInventory
    UpdateStorage

    UpdateCardColors
    UpdateCompletion
    UpdateIncompleteSummary
    UpdateNextAction

Exit_Handler:
    Exit Sub

Err_Handler:
    MsgBox _
        "The System Setup status could not be refreshed." & _
        vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "Error Number: " & Err.Number & vbCrLf & _
        "Source: " & Err.Source & vbCrLf & _
        "Details: " & Err.Description, _
        vbExclamation, _
        "System Setup"
    Resume Exit_Handler

End Sub


'=============================================================
' LOAD TOTAL AND INCOMPLETE COUNTS
'=============================================================

Private Sub LoadSetupMetrics()

    Dim externalCustomerCriteria As String

    externalCustomerCriteria = _
        "UCase(Trim(Nz([CustomerType],'')))<>'INTERNAL'"

    mCustomerTotal = CountDomainRecords("T_Customers", externalCustomerCriteria)
    mCustomerIncomplete = CountDomainRecords( _
        "T_Customers", _
        "(" & externalCustomerCriteria & ") AND (" & _
            CustomerIncompleteCriteria() & ")")

    mSupplierTotal = CountDomainRecords("T_Suppliers")
    mSupplierIncomplete = CountDomainRecords( _
        "T_Suppliers", _
        SupplierIncompleteCriteria())

    mCategoryTotal = CountDomainRecords("T_Categories")
    mCategoryIncomplete = CountDomainRecords( _
        "T_Categories", _
        CategoryIncompleteCriteria())

    mUnitTotal = CountDomainRecords("T_Units")
    mUnitIncomplete = CountDomainRecords( _
        "T_Units", _
        UnitIncompleteCriteria())

    mItemTotal = CountDomainRecords("T_Items")
    mItemIncomplete = CountDomainRecords( _
        "T_Items", _
        ItemIncompleteCriteria())

    mTemplateTotal = CountDomainRecords("T_AssemblyTemplates")
    mTemplateIncomplete = CountDomainRecords( _
        "T_AssemblyTemplates", _
        TemplateIncompleteCriteria())

    mWarehouseTotal = CountDomainRecords("T_Warehouses")
    mWarehouseIncomplete = CountDomainRecords( _
        "T_Warehouses", _
        WarehouseIncompleteCriteria())

    mLocationTotal = CountDomainRecords("T_Locations")
    mLocationIncomplete = CountDomainRecords( _
        "T_Locations", _
        LocationIncompleteCriteria())

End Sub
'=============================================================
' PARTNERS CARD
'=============================================================

Private Sub UpdatePartners()

    ApplyAreaStatus _
        Me.lblCustomerStatus, _
        Me.cmdCustomerSetup, _
        mCustomerTotal, _
        mCustomerIncomplete, _
        "customer", _
        "customers", _
        "Add Customers", _
        "Manage Customers", _
        "Review Customers"

    ApplyAreaStatus _
        Me.lblSupplierStatus, _
        Me.cmdSupplierSetup, _
        mSupplierTotal, _
        mSupplierIncomplete, _
        "supplier", _
        "suppliers", _
        "Add Suppliers", _
        "Manage Suppliers", _
        "Review Suppliers"

End Sub


'=============================================================
' INVENTORY CARD
'=============================================================

Private Sub UpdateInventory()

    ApplyAreaStatus _
        Me.lblCategoryStatus, _
        Me.cmdCategorySetup, _
        mCategoryTotal, _
        mCategoryIncomplete, _
        "category", _
        "categories", _
        "Add Categories", _
        "Add Category", _
        "Review Categories"

    ApplyAreaStatus _
        Me.lblUnitStatus, _
        Me.cmdUnitSetup, _
        mUnitTotal, _
        mUnitIncomplete, _
        "unit", _
        "units", _
        "Add Units", _
        "Add Units", _
        "Review Units"

    ApplyAreaStatus _
        Me.lblItemStatus, _
        Me.cmdItemSetup, _
        mItemTotal, _
        mItemIncomplete, _
        "item", _
        "items", _
        "Add Items", _
        "Manage Items", _
        "Review Items"

    ApplyAreaStatus _
        Me.lblTemplateStatus, _
        Me.cmdTemplateSetup, _
        mTemplateTotal, _
        mTemplateIncomplete, _
        "template", _
        "templates", _
        "Add Templates", _
        "Manage Templates", _
        "Review Templates"

End Sub


'=============================================================
' STORAGE CARD
'=============================================================

Private Sub UpdateStorage()

    ApplyAreaStatus _
        Me.lblWarehouseStatus, _
        Me.cmdWarehouseSetup, _
        mWarehouseTotal, _
        mWarehouseIncomplete, _
        "warehouse", _
        "warehouses", _
        "Add Warehouse", _
        "Manage Warehouses", _
        "Review Warehouses"

    ApplyAreaStatus _
        Me.lblLocationStatus, _
        Me.cmdLocationSetup, _
        mLocationTotal, _
        mLocationIncomplete, _
        "location", _
        "locations", _
        "Add Location", _
        "Manage Locations", _
        "Review Locations"

End Sub


'=============================================================
' APPLY ONE AREA'S STATUS TEXT, BUTTON AND COLOUR
'=============================================================

Private Sub ApplyAreaStatus( _
    ByVal statusLabel As Control, _
    ByVal actionButton As Control, _
    ByVal totalCount As Long, _
    ByVal incompleteCount As Long, _
    ByVal singularName As String, _
    ByVal pluralName As String, _
    ByVal addCaption As String, _
    ByVal manageCaption As String, _
    ByVal reviewCaption As String _
)

    Dim readyCount As Long

    readyCount = ReadyRecordCount( _
        totalCount, _
        incompleteCount)

    If totalCount = 0 Then

        statusLabel.Caption = _
            "No " & pluralName & " set up"

        statusLabel.ForeColor = RGB(192, 0, 0)
        actionButton.Caption = addCaption

    ElseIf incompleteCount > 0 Then

        statusLabel.Caption = _
            CountPhrase( _
                readyCount, _
                singularName, _
                pluralName) & _
            " ready; " & _
            CountPhrase( _
                incompleteCount, _
                singularName, _
                pluralName) & _
            " incomplete"

        statusLabel.ForeColor = RGB(192, 96, 0)
        actionButton.Caption = reviewCaption

    Else

        statusLabel.Caption = _
            CountPhrase( _
                totalCount, _
                singularName, _
                pluralName) & _
            " ready"

        statusLabel.ForeColor = RGB(0, 128, 0)
        actionButton.Caption = manageCaption

    End If

End Sub


'=============================================================
' SETUP COMPLETION
'=============================================================

Private Sub UpdateCompletion()

    Dim totalAreas As Long
    Dim completeAreas As Long
    Dim completionPercent As Long

    totalAreas = 8
    completeAreas = CompletedAreaCount()

    completionPercent = Int( _
        (CDbl(completeAreas) / CDbl(totalAreas)) * 100)

    Me.lblSetupProgress.Caption = _
        "Setup Completion: " & completionPercent & "%"

    Me.lblSetupSummary.Caption = _
        completeAreas & " of " & totalAreas & _
        " setup areas completed"

End Sub


Private Function CompletedAreaCount() As Long

    Dim result As Long

    If AreaIsComplete( _
        mCustomerTotal, _
        mCustomerIncomplete) Then result = result + 1

    If AreaIsComplete( _
        mSupplierTotal, _
        mSupplierIncomplete) Then result = result + 1

    If AreaIsComplete( _
        mCategoryTotal, _
        mCategoryIncomplete) Then result = result + 1

    If AreaIsComplete( _
        mUnitTotal, _
        mUnitIncomplete) Then result = result + 1

    If AreaIsComplete( _
        mItemTotal, _
        mItemIncomplete) Then result = result + 1

    If AreaIsComplete( _
        mTemplateTotal, _
        mTemplateIncomplete) Then result = result + 1

    If AreaIsComplete( _
        mWarehouseTotal, _
        mWarehouseIncomplete) Then result = result + 1

    If AreaIsComplete( _
        mLocationTotal, _
        mLocationIncomplete) Then result = result + 1

    CompletedAreaCount = result

End Function


'=============================================================
' OVERALL INCOMPLETE-RECORD STATUS
'=============================================================

Private Sub UpdateIncompleteSummary()

    Dim incompleteRecords As Long
    Dim incompleteAreas As Long

    incompleteRecords = _
        mCustomerIncomplete + _
        mSupplierIncomplete + _
        mCategoryIncomplete + _
        mUnitIncomplete + _
        mItemIncomplete + _
        mTemplateIncomplete + _
        mWarehouseIncomplete + _
        mLocationIncomplete

    If mCustomerIncomplete > 0 Then
        incompleteAreas = incompleteAreas + 1
    End If

    If mSupplierIncomplete > 0 Then
        incompleteAreas = incompleteAreas + 1
    End If

    If mCategoryIncomplete > 0 Then
        incompleteAreas = incompleteAreas + 1
    End If

    If mUnitIncomplete > 0 Then
        incompleteAreas = incompleteAreas + 1
    End If

    If mItemIncomplete > 0 Then
        incompleteAreas = incompleteAreas + 1
    End If

    If mTemplateIncomplete > 0 Then
        incompleteAreas = incompleteAreas + 1
    End If

    If mWarehouseIncomplete > 0 Then
        incompleteAreas = incompleteAreas + 1
    End If

    If mLocationIncomplete > 0 Then
        incompleteAreas = incompleteAreas + 1
    End If

    If incompleteRecords = 0 Then

        Me.lblIncompleteSummary.Caption = _
            "No incomplete saved records"

        Me.lblIncompleteSummary.ForeColor = RGB(0, 128, 0)

    Else

        Me.lblIncompleteSummary.Caption = _
            CountPhrase( _
                incompleteRecords, _
                "incomplete record", _
                "incomplete records") & _
            " across " & _
            CountPhrase( _
                incompleteAreas, _
                "setup area", _
                "setup areas")

        Me.lblIncompleteSummary.ForeColor = RGB(192, 96, 0)

    End If

End Sub


'=============================================================
' NEXT ACTION
'=============================================================

Private Sub UpdateNextAction()

    'Storage must exist before item default locations can be used.
    If mWarehouseTotal = 0 Then
        SetNextAction _
            "Start by creating a warehouse.", _
            "Create Warehouse"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If mWarehouseIncomplete > 0 Then
        SetNextAction _
            MissingDetailsMessage( _
                mWarehouseIncomplete, _
                "warehouse record", _
                "warehouse records"), _
            "Review Warehouses"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If mLocationTotal = 0 Then
        SetNextAction _
            "Create at least one warehouse location.", _
            "Create Location"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If mLocationIncomplete > 0 Then
        SetNextAction _
            MissingDetailsMessage( _
                mLocationIncomplete, _
                "location record", _
                "location records"), _
            "Review Locations"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If mCategoryTotal = 0 Then
        SetNextAction _
            "Create categories before adding items.", _
            "Create Categories"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If mCategoryIncomplete > 0 Then
        SetNextAction _
            MissingDetailsMessage( _
                mCategoryIncomplete, _
                "category record", _
                "category records"), _
            "Review Categories"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If mUnitTotal = 0 Then
        SetNextAction _
            "Create measurement units.", _
            "Create Units"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If mUnitIncomplete > 0 Then
        SetNextAction _
            MissingDetailsMessage( _
                mUnitIncomplete, _
                "unit record", _
                "unit records"), _
            "Review Units"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If mCustomerTotal = 0 Then
        SetNextAction _
            "Create at least one customer.", _
            "Create Customer"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If mCustomerIncomplete > 0 Then
        SetNextAction _
            MissingDetailsMessage( _
                mCustomerIncomplete, _
                "customer record", _
                "customer records"), _
            "Review Customers"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If mSupplierTotal = 0 Then
        SetNextAction _
            "Create at least one supplier.", _
            "Create Supplier"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If mSupplierIncomplete > 0 Then
        SetNextAction _
            MissingDetailsMessage( _
                mSupplierIncomplete, _
                "supplier record", _
                "supplier records"), _
            "Review Suppliers"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If mItemTotal = 0 Then
        SetNextAction _
            "Add your inventory items.", _
            "Add Items"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If mItemIncomplete > 0 Then
        SetNextAction _
            MissingDetailsMessage( _
                mItemIncomplete, _
                "item record", _
                "item records"), _
            "Review Items"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If mTemplateTotal = 0 Then
        SetNextAction _
            "Create at least one assembly template.", _
            "Create Template"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If mTemplateIncomplete > 0 Then
        SetNextAction _
            MissingDetailsMessage( _
                mTemplateIncomplete, _
                "template record", _
                "template records"), _
            "Review Templates"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    SetNextAction _
        "System setup is complete.", _
        "Completed"

End Sub


Private Sub SetNextAction( _
    ByVal actionText As String, _
    ByVal buttonCaption As String _
)

    Me.lblNextAction.Caption = actionText
    Me.cmdNextAction.Caption = buttonCaption

End Sub


Private Function MissingDetailsMessage( _
    ByVal recordCount As Long, _
    ByVal singularName As String, _
    ByVal pluralName As String _
) As String

    MissingDetailsMessage = _
        CountPhrase( _
            recordCount, _
            singularName, _
            pluralName) & _
        " need required details."

End Function


'=============================================================
' CARD COLOURS
'=============================================================

Private Sub UpdateCardColors()

    UpdatePartnersCard
    UpdateInventoryCard
    UpdateStorageCard

End Sub


Private Sub SetCardColor( _
    ByVal ctrl As Control, _
    ByVal clr As Long _
)

    On Error Resume Next

    ctrl.BackStyle = 1
    ctrl.BackColor = clr

    On Error GoTo 0

End Sub


Private Sub UpdatePartnersCard()

    If AreaIsComplete( _
        mCustomerTotal, _
        mCustomerIncomplete) And _
       AreaIsComplete( _
        mSupplierTotal, _
        mSupplierIncomplete) Then

        SetCardColor _
            Me.shpPartnersCard, _
            RGB(220, 240, 220)

    ElseIf mCustomerTotal > 0 Or _
           mSupplierTotal > 0 Then

        SetCardColor _
            Me.shpPartnersCard, _
            RGB(255, 245, 200)

    Else

        SetCardColor _
            Me.shpPartnersCard, _
            RGB(255, 220, 220)

    End If

End Sub


Private Sub UpdateInventoryCard()

    If AreaIsComplete( _
        mCategoryTotal, _
        mCategoryIncomplete) And _
       AreaIsComplete( _
        mUnitTotal, _
        mUnitIncomplete) And _
       AreaIsComplete( _
        mItemTotal, _
        mItemIncomplete) And _
       AreaIsComplete( _
        mTemplateTotal, _
        mTemplateIncomplete) Then

        SetCardColor _
            Me.shpInventoryCard, _
            RGB(220, 240, 220)

    ElseIf mCategoryTotal > 0 Or _
           mUnitTotal > 0 Or _
           mItemTotal > 0 Or _
           mTemplateTotal > 0 Then

        SetCardColor _
            Me.shpInventoryCard, _
            RGB(255, 245, 200)

    Else

        SetCardColor _
            Me.shpInventoryCard, _
            RGB(255, 220, 220)

    End If

End Sub


Private Sub UpdateStorageCard()

    If AreaIsComplete( _
        mWarehouseTotal, _
        mWarehouseIncomplete) And _
       AreaIsComplete( _
        mLocationTotal, _
        mLocationIncomplete) Then

        SetCardColor _
            Me.shpStorageCard, _
            RGB(220, 240, 220)

    ElseIf mWarehouseTotal > 0 Or _
           mLocationTotal > 0 Then

        SetCardColor _
            Me.shpStorageCard, _
            RGB(255, 245, 200)

    Else

        SetCardColor _
            Me.shpStorageCard, _
            RGB(255, 220, 220)

    End If

End Sub


'=============================================================
' COMPLETENESS CRITERIA
'=============================================================

Private Function CustomerIncompleteCriteria() As String

    CustomerIncompleteCriteria = AnyMissing( _
        BlankTextCriteria("CustomerName"))

End Function
Private Function SupplierIncompleteCriteria() As String

    SupplierIncompleteCriteria = AnyMissing( _
        BlankTextCriteria("CompanyName"))

End Function
Private Function CategoryIncompleteCriteria() As String

    CategoryIncompleteCriteria = AnyMissing( _
        BlankTextCriteria("CategoryName"), _
        MissingKeyCriteria("ItemTypeID"), _
        "[RequiresSerial] Is Null", _
        "[RequiresExpiry] Is Null")

End Function


Private Function UnitIncompleteCriteria() As String

    UnitIncompleteCriteria = AnyMissing( _
        BlankTextCriteria("UnitCode"), _
        BlankTextCriteria("UnitName"))

End Function


Private Function ItemIncompleteCriteria() As String

    ItemIncompleteCriteria = AnyMissing( _
        BlankTextCriteria("InternalSKU"), _
        BlankTextCriteria("ItemName"), _
        BlankTextCriteria("ItemClass"), _
        MissingKeyCriteria("CategoryID"), _
        MissingKeyCriteria("BaseUnitID"), _
        MissingKeyCriteria("DefaultLocationID"), _
        "[ReorderLevel] Is Null", _
        "[MinStockLevel] Is Null", _
        "[MaxStockLevel] Is Null", _
        "[RequiresSerial] Is Null", _
        "(Nz([RequiresSerial],0)<>0 AND " & _
            BlankTextCriteria("SerialNumber") & ")")

End Function


Private Function TemplateIncompleteCriteria() As String

    TemplateIncompleteCriteria = AnyMissing( _
        BlankTextCriteria("TemplateCode"), _
        BlankTextCriteria("TemplateName"), _
        MissingKeyCriteria("CustomerID"), _
        "([OutputQuantity] Is Null OR [OutputQuantity]<=0)", _
        BlankTextCriteria("RevisionNo"), _
        BlankTextCriteria("Status"), _
        "[EstimatedLaborHours] Is Null", _
        "[EstimatedMaterialCost] Is Null", _
        "[EstimatedTotalCost] Is Null")

End Function


Private Function WarehouseIncompleteCriteria() As String

    WarehouseIncompleteCriteria = AnyMissing( _
        BlankTextCriteria("WarehouseName"))

End Function
Private Function LocationIncompleteCriteria() As String

    LocationIncompleteCriteria = AnyMissing( _
        MissingKeyCriteria("WarehouseID"), _
        BlankTextCriteria("LocationCode"), _
        BlankTextCriteria("LocationName"))

End Function
'=============================================================
' CRITERIA BUILDERS
'=============================================================

Private Function BlankTextCriteria( _
    ByVal fieldName As String _
) As String

    BlankTextCriteria = _
        "Len(Trim(Nz([" & fieldName & "],'')))=0"

End Function


Private Function MissingKeyCriteria( _
    ByVal fieldName As String _
) As String

    MissingKeyCriteria = _
        "Nz([" & fieldName & "],0)=0"

End Function


Private Function AnyMissing( _
    ParamArray expressions() As Variant _
) As String

    Dim result As String
    Dim oneExpression As Variant

    For Each oneExpression In expressions

        If Len(Trim$(CStr(oneExpression))) > 0 Then

            If Len(result) > 0 Then
                result = result & " OR "
            End If

            result = result & _
                "(" & CStr(oneExpression) & ")"

        End If

    Next oneExpression

    AnyMissing = result

End Function


'=============================================================
' DOMAIN COUNT WITH VISIBLE ERRORS
'=============================================================

Private Function CountDomainRecords( _
    ByVal tableName As String, _
    Optional ByVal criteria As String = vbNullString _
) As Long

    Dim originalDescription As String
    Dim originalNumber As Long

    On Error GoTo Err_Handler

    If Len(Trim$(criteria)) = 0 Then
        CountDomainRecords = DCount("*", tableName)
    Else
        CountDomainRecords = DCount( _
            "*", _
            tableName, _
            criteria)
    End If

Exit_Handler:
    Exit Function

Err_Handler:
    originalNumber = Err.Number
    originalDescription = Err.Description

    Err.Raise _
        vbObjectError + 8101, _
        "CountDomainRecords", _
        "Completeness could not be evaluated for " & _
        tableName & "." & _
        vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "Check that every field in the completeness rule " & _
        "exists in that table." & _
        vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "Original error " & originalNumber & ": " & _
        originalDescription

End Function


'=============================================================
' GENERAL COUNT HELPERS
'=============================================================

Private Function AreaIsComplete( _
    ByVal totalCount As Long, _
    ByVal incompleteCount As Long _
) As Boolean

    AreaIsComplete = _
        (totalCount > 0 And incompleteCount = 0)

End Function


Private Function ReadyRecordCount( _
    ByVal totalCount As Long, _
    ByVal incompleteCount As Long _
) As Long

    If incompleteCount >= totalCount Then
        ReadyRecordCount = 0
    Else
        ReadyRecordCount = totalCount - incompleteCount
    End If

End Function


Private Function CountPhrase( _
    ByVal recordCount As Long, _
    ByVal singularName As String, _
    ByVal pluralName As String _
) As String

    If recordCount = 1 Then
        CountPhrase = recordCount & " " & singularName
    Else
        CountPhrase = recordCount & " " & pluralName
    End If

End Function


'=============================================================
' BUTTONS - EXISTING DESTINATIONS PRESERVED
'=============================================================

Private Sub cmdCustomerSetup_Click()

    DoCmd.OpenForm "F_CustomerList"

End Sub


Private Sub cmdSupplierSetup_Click()

    DoCmd.OpenForm "F_SupplierList"

End Sub


Private Sub cmdCategorySetup_Click()

    DoCmd.OpenForm "F_CategoriesList"

End Sub
Private Sub cmdUnitSetup_Click()

    DoCmd.OpenForm "F_UnitSetup"

End Sub


Private Sub cmdItemSetup_Click()

    DoCmd.OpenForm "F_ItemSetupList"

End Sub


Private Sub cmdTemplateSetup_Click()

    DoCmd.OpenForm "F_TemplateList"

End Sub


Private Sub cmdWarehouseSetup_Click()

    DoCmd.OpenForm "F_WarehouseList"

End Sub


Private Sub cmdLocationSetup_Click()

    DoCmd.OpenForm "F_LocationSetup"

End Sub


Private Sub cmdRefresh_Click()

    RefreshSetup

End Sub


Private Sub cmdNextAction_Click()

    On Error GoTo Err_Handler

    Select Case Nz(Me.cmdNextAction.Caption, vbNullString)
        Case "Create Warehouse", "Review Warehouses", "Manage Warehouses"
            DoCmd.OpenForm "F_WarehouseList"
        Case "Create Location", "Review Locations"
            DoCmd.OpenForm "F_LocationSetup"
        Case "Create Categories", "Review Categories"
            DoCmd.OpenForm "F_CategoriesList"
        Case "Create Units", "Review Units"
            DoCmd.OpenForm "F_UnitSetup"
        Case "Create Customer", "Review Customers", "Manage Customers"
            DoCmd.OpenForm "F_CustomerList"
        Case "Create Supplier", "Review Suppliers", "Manage Suppliers"
            DoCmd.OpenForm "F_SupplierList"
        Case "Add Items", "Review Items"
            DoCmd.OpenForm "F_ItemSetupList"
        Case "Create Template", "Review Templates"
            DoCmd.OpenForm "F_TemplateList"
        Case Else
            RefreshSetup
    End Select

Exit_Handler:
    Exit Sub

Err_Handler:
    MsgBox _
        "The selected setup action could not be opened." & _
        vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "Action: " & Nz(Me.cmdNextAction.Caption, vbNullString) & _
        vbCrLf & "Error Number: " & Err.Number & _
        vbCrLf & "Details: " & Err.Description, _
        vbExclamation, _
        "System Setup"
    Resume Exit_Handler

End Sub
